text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... Even after you gave 
me time off, I couldn't get myself into 
proper shape.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I've been getting congested pretty easily 
lately. It was especially bad last night.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I adjusted the humidity, put on nasal 
strips, and everything... but I just 
couldn't fall asleep."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“...Well, excuses won't get me anywhere! 
I'll put my all into training, so please 
guide me well, Trainer!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her persistent positive attitude is 
admirable. However, after spending an 
uncomfortable, sleepless night, it seems 
she wasn't able to rest well...
